# Brand Signages - Complete Service & Product Documentation

> Premier B2B Sign Board Manufacturer & Custom Signage Company in Bangalore & PAN India.

Brand Signages (established 2014) is a premier signage manufacturing company based in Bangalore, India, delivering over 12,000+ custom signage installations across India.

## Product Portfolio

### 1. LED Acrylic Glow Sign Boards
Custom LED 3D glow sign boards built with premium grade acrylic, energy-efficient LED modules, and IP67 weather protection for maximum visibility day and night.

### 2. Acrylic Letters & Signages
Laser-cut custom acrylic letters, crystal acrylic badges, back-lit logo signages, and polished acrylic nameplates for corporate offices and commercial spaces.

### 3. Neon Signs
Handcrafted custom LED neon signs available in vibrant color spectrums, ideal for cafes, retail stores, boutique offices, events, and modern home decor.

### 4. Digital Signage Solutions
Commercial-grade LED & LCD digital display screens, kiosk displays, video walls, and digital menu boards equipped with remote content management.

### 5. Metal Signages & Name Boards
Heavy-duty stainless steel (SS 304/316 grade), brass, and aluminum composite panel (ACP) signages engineered for durability and premium aesthetic appeal.

### 6. Indoor & Office Signages
Comprehensive interior branding solutions including reception backdrop signages, frosted glass films, wall graphics, safety signs, and wayfinding signage.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What materials are best for outdoor sign boards?
Acrylic with LED modules, Stainless Steel (SS), and Aluminum Composite Panels (ACP) offer high durability, UV resistance, and weatherproofing for outdoor signage.

### Do you provide site installation across India?
Yes, Brand Signages provides full site measurement, custom design, fabrication, and professional installation services across Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, and PAN India.
